Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。但是不知道为什么，没有办法。所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物：古代的时候，人们
- 所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险：是安全的，是危险的
- 发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚：add他in the beginning; delete 感觉，又暖和又舒服

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar, error] 告诉人什么植物是安… → 告诉人们什么植物是安… -- Use 人们 when you mean people in general.
2. [Grammar, error] …么植物是安全什么是危险 → …么植物是安全的什么是危险 -- 安全 describes the omitted noun 植物, so use 的: 是安全的.
3. [Grammar, error] …全什么是危险 → …全什么是危险的 -- 危险 describes the omitted noun 植物, so use 的: 是危险的.
4. [Vocabulary, error] 神农出去试一试很多种植物 → 神农出去尝了很多种植物 -- 试一试 does not normally collocate with plants in this situation; use 尝了 instead.
5. [Coherence: reference, suggestion] 人不知道他们能吃什么植物 → 人不知道自己能吃什么植物 -- It would be more natural to use 自己 to refer back to generic 人.
6. [Coherence: reference, error] ⟦神农⟧出去试一试很… -- 神农 appears for the first time, so please introduce him briefly with an identifying noun phrase.
7. [Other, error] 古代时候 → 古代 -- 时候 is redundant because 古代 already expresses the time.

items.reason: 人 cannot refer to a concrete general group under the teacher's rule, so 人们 is needed, but the displayed text is cut off.
安全 needs 的 here, but the corrected excerpt still leaves 是危险 without 的.
危险 needs 的 here, but the corrected excerpt still leaves 是安全 without 的.
试一试很多种植物 is an acceptable way to say he tested various plants, even though 尝了 is also suitable in this story.
他们 can refer back to the general people; moreover, changing it to 自己 leaves the teacher-required 人→人们 issue unfixed.
神农 is first introduced here and should be briefly identified, but the item supplies no corrected Chinese text.
古代时候 lacks the required 的 in the teacher's correction, and replacing it with the grammatical time phrase 古代 also resolves the problem.
